title: FIGURE_AUDITS.json - all-figure audit summary mirror
description: Mirror of the per-figure figure_audit.json verdicts, maintained by unified-plotting Step 6.5 (v5.3) so downstream skills (/paper-writing, /paper-compile) can read every figure's audit state from one flat .sciforge/verdicts/ file. Per-figure detail stays in figures/<name>/figure_audit.json.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 time of the most recent mirror update.

verdict.description: Verdict copied from the figure's figure_audit.json.

audit_file.description: Workspace-relative path of the detailed audit file.
